def getStateColor(chkShtState):	#can't use var colors in the chart;(
		for chkState in self.view.custom.stateColors:
			if chkState.state == chkShtState: return chkState.color
		return '#D5D5D5'

	def buildSeries(seriesNum, seriesName, dataName, seriesColor):
		return {
				"name": "Series_" + str(seriesNum),
				"label": {"text": seriesName},
				"visible": True,
				"hiddenInLegend": False,
				"defaultState": {"visible": True},
				"data": {"source": dataName, "x": "value", "y": "category"},
				"xAxis": "Status",
				"yAxis": "Count",
				"zIndex": 0,
				"tooltip": {"enabled": True, "text": "{name}: [bold]{value}[/]", "cornerRadius": 3, "pointerLength": 4, "background": {"color": "", "opacity": 1}},
				"render": "column", "candlestick": {"open": {"x": "", "y": ""}, "high": {"x": "", "y": ""}, "low": {"x": "", "y": ""}, "appearance": {"fill": {"color": "", "opacity": 1}, "stroke": {"color": "", "opacity": 1, "width": 1},
				"stacked": True,
				"deriveFieldsFromData": {"fill": {"color": "", "opacity": ""}, "stroke": {"color": "", "opacity": "", "width": ""}},
				"heatRules": {"enabled": False,"max": "","min": "","dataField": ""}}},
				"column": {"open": {"x": "","y": ""},
				"appearance": {"fill": {"color": seriesColor,"opacity": 1},
				"stroke": {"color": "","opacity": 1,"width": 0},
				"width": None,
				"height": None,
				"stacked": True,
				"deriveFieldsFromData": {"fill": {"color": "","opacity": ""},	"stroke": {"color": "","opacity": "","width": ""}},
				"heatRules": {"enabled": False,"max": "","min": "","dataField": ""}
				}},
				"line": {"open": {"x": "","y": ""},
				"appearance": {"connect": True,"tensionX": 1,"tensionY": 1,"minDistance": 0.5,"stroke": {"width": 3,"opacity": 1,"color": "","dashArray": ""},
				"fill": {"color": "","opacity": 0},
				"bullets": [
						{"enabled": False,"render": "circle","width": 10,"height": 10,"label": {"text": "{value}","position": {"dx": 0,"dy": 0}},
						"tooltip": {"enabled": True,"text": "{name}: [bold]{valueY}[/]","cornerRadius": 3,"pointerLength": 4,"background": {"color": "","opacity": 1}},
						"fill": {"color": "","opacity": 1},
						"stroke": {"color": "","width": 1,"opacity": 1},
						"rotation": 0,
						"deriveFieldsFromData": {"fill": {"color": "","opacity": ""},"stroke": {"color": "","opacity": "","width": ""},"rotation": ""},
						"heatRules": {"enabled": False,"max": 100,"min": 2,"dataField": ""}}
					]
	}},}

	data = system.dataset.toPyDataSet(value)
	if data is not None:	
		chartData = []
		colHdrs = system.dataset.getColumnHeaders(data)
		colHdrs.pop(colHdrs.index('Total'))
		colHdrs.pop(colHdrs.index('Category'))
		if 'shiftNameId' in colHdrs: colHdrs.pop(colHdrs.index('shiftNameId'))
		if 'itemId' in colHdrs: colHdrs.pop(colHdrs.index('itemId'))
		chartDataList = [[] for col in colHdrs]

		for row in data:
			for col in colHdrs:
				chartDataList[colHdrs.index(col)].append({"value":row[col], "category": row['Category']})	

	datasources = {}
	seriesList = []

	for i, item in enumerate(chartDataList):
		chkShtState = colHdrs[i]
		dataName = chkShtState.replace(" ", "_") + '_Data'
		datasources.update({dataName: item})
		seriesList.append(buildSeries(i, chkShtState, dataName, getStateColor(chkShtState)))		

	self.props.series = seriesList
	
	return datasources

	elif chkShtInfo['auto']: chkShtInfo['auto'] = True
	else: chkShtInfo['auto'] = False
	
	category = chkShtInfo['groupBy']
	if category is None: return []

	data = system.kanoa.quality.analysis.getShiftHeatMap(chkShtInfo, category)

	chartData = []
	colHdrs = system.dataset.getColumnHeaders(data)
	
	for row in range(data.rowCount):
		category = data.getValueAt(row, 'Category')
		for col in range(1, data.getColumnCount()):
			shift = colHdrs[col]
			value = data.getValueAt(row, col)
			if value is None: bgColor = kanoaScripts.colors.getCSSColor('--kcSurfaceVariant', 'dark' in self.session.props.theme)	#grey
			elif value >= 95: bgColor = kanoaScripts.colors.getCSSColor('--kcGood', 'dark' in self.session.props.theme)	#green
			elif value >= 75: kanoaScripts.colors.getCSSColor('--kcOK', 'dark' in self.session.props.theme)	#yellow
			else: bgColor = kanoaScripts.colors.getCSSColor('--kcBad', 'dark' in self.session.props.theme)	#red
	
			chartData.append({"value":value, "categoryX": shift, "categoryY": category, "bgColor": bgColor})

	return {'data': chartData}

system.perspective.print("itemSelected() msg rcvd by chkSummary with %s"%payload)

	items = []
	itemClasses = []

	for entry in payload['selection']:
		if entry['value'].has_key('itemId') and entry['value']['itemId'] is not None:
			system.perspective.print("adding itemId %s"%entry['value']['itemId'])
			items.append({'itemPath':entry['value']['path'], 'itemId': entry['value']['itemId']})
		else:
			itemClassId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemClassId', system.kanoa.item.getItemClasses({'itemClassPath' :entry['value']['path']}))
			system.perspective.print("adding itemClassId %s for %s"%(entry['value']['path'], itemClassId))
			itemClasses.append({'itemClassPath':entry['value']['path'], 'itemClassId': itemClassId})

	self.view.custom.filters.items = items
	self.view.custom.filters.itemClasses = itemClasses

	return
